Company Description: BENEO offers a range of functional ingredients with health and technical benefits derived from the natural sources chicory root, barley, sugar beet, rice, wheat and faba bean. With its Meatless range, BENEO offers food producers a versatile selection of plant-based texturizing solutions for meat and fish alternatives. By “connecting nutrition and health”, the company supports food and feed manufacturers to produce healthy and more balanced products. BENEO also supplies organic rice ingredients for green, clean, texturizing solutions and organic chicory root fibres, offering the same prebiotic benefits as our conventional ingredients. BENEO ingredients offer food manufacturers routes to develop great-tasting products that are nutritionally optimised with less or no sugar or fat, fibre-enriched or gluten- as well as dairy-free and more. BENEO takes it even further: blood sugar management, weight management, digestive, bone and dental health are concepts where its ingredients can play a decisive role. In addition, they improve the taste and texture of food and beverages. BENEO specialises in supplying manufacturers with functional ingredients of non-animal origin that bring forth innovative product development. The company’s product portfolio is primarily used in the following applications: baby food, bakery, cereals, beverages, confectionery, dairy, meat and vegetables, as well as soups and sauces.
